schemas.BasicResponse: Base envelope returned by every API call, indicating whether the request succeeded.
schemas.Error: An error reported by the API, with a code and a human-readable description.
schemas.ErrorResponse: Response envelope returned when a request fails.
schemas.Pagination: Paging details for a list result.
schemas.PaginatedResponse: Base envelope for list results, adding pagination details to the basic response.
schemas.UpdatedBy: The user or process that made a change to a record.
schemas.Updated: Audit information recording when and by whom a record was changed.
schemas.AccountBalance: The current balance of a Sakari account and the message segments it can pay for.
schemas.DataType: Data type of a property value.
schemas.InternationalNumber: A phone number together with its country and validation details.
schemas.Time: A time of day expressed as an hour and minute.
schemas.Hours: A time range within a day, with a start and an end time.
schemas.Times: Weekly schedule of time ranges, listed per day of the week.
schemas.Autoresponder: A rule that automatically replies to incoming messages matching a pattern.
schemas.CampaignRequest: Request payload for creating a campaign.
schemas.QuickCampaignRequest: Request payload for creating a campaign and executing it immediately or at a scheduled time.
schemas.Campaign: A reusable message campaign with its contact filters, template, schedule and reporting settings.
schemas.CampaignExecution: A single run of a campaign and its delivery results.
schemas.CampaignFilter: Criteria that select which contacts a campaign is sent to.
schemas.Schedule: When and how often a campaign runs.
schemas.WorkflowDataReference: A reference to a value available within a workflow, such as a workflow property, a node output, a contact attribute or an event field.
schemas.Condition: A comparison applied to a contact attribute to filter contacts.
schemas.ContactList: A list that a contact belongs to, with the contact's opt-in and opt-out dates for that list.
schemas.Contact: A contact in the Sakari address book.
schemas.ContactFilter: Criteria that select contacts, used to define the members of a list.
schemas.Conversation: A message thread between the account and a single contact.
schemas.DripCampaignStats: Contact counts that summarise the progress of a drip campaign or one of its messages.
schemas.DripCampaignMessage: A message sent as one step of a drip campaign, after a delay.
schemas.DripCampaign: A drip campaign that sends a sequence of timed messages to contacts after a trigger event.
schemas.CreateUpdateDripCampaign: Request payload for creating or updating a drip campaign.
schemas.DripCampaignExecution: A contact's progress through a drip campaign.
schemas.EventType: Type of event that a webhook can be notified about.
schemas.FieldMapping: Maps a column of an uploaded file to a contact attribute.
schemas.Form: A web form that collects contact sign-ups.
schemas.Group: A group of phone numbers, senders and users that send and receive messages together.
schemas.GroupNotification: A notification destination configured for a group.
schemas.GroupOfficeHours: Office hours configured for a group.
schemas.Media: A media file attached to a message.
schemas.Message: An SMS or MMS message sent to or received from a contact.
schemas.AvailablePhoneNumber: A phone number that is available to be added to the account.
schemas.Channel: Base settings shared by every phone number channel.
schemas.PhoneNumber: A phone number used by the account to send and receive messages.
schemas.PhoneNumberChannels: The SMS, voice and WhatsApp channels configured for a phone number or sender.
schemas.Sender: A sender identity, such as a phone number, used to send messages.
schemas.SmsChannel: SMS channel settings for a phone number or sender.
schemas.SmsRegulatory: Carrier registration details for sending SMS from a phone number.
schemas.SupportedDestinations: Map of destination countries to whether messages can be sent to them.
schemas.VoiceChannel: Voice channel settings for a phone number or sender.
schemas.WhatsappChannel: WhatsApp channel settings for a phone number or sender.
schemas.Link: A tracked short link that records clicks on a destination URL.
schemas.LinkSource: A source of clicks on a tracked link, with its click statistics.
schemas.LinkSourceStat: Click count for a tracked link source on a given date.
schemas.Person: Basic details of a person, such as a contact or a user.
schemas.Template: A reusable message or web template.
schemas.User: A user of the Sakari account.
schemas.Webhook: A subscription that notifies a destination URL when selected events occur.
schemas.Workflow: An automated workflow and its versions.
schemas.WorkflowDefinition: The nodes, edges and properties that define a workflow version.
schemas.WorkflowEdgeType: Type of an edge connecting two workflow nodes.
schemas.WorkflowEdge: A connection from one workflow node to another.
schemas.WorkflowProperty: A named property that holds a value while a workflow runs.
schemas.WorkflowNode: A trigger or action step in a workflow.
schemas.MessageReceivedTriggerConfig: Configuration of a trigger that starts a workflow when a message is received.
schemas.LinkClickedTriggerConfig: Configuration of a trigger that starts a workflow when a tracked link is clicked.
schemas.MessageStatusTriggerConfig: Configuration of a trigger that starts a workflow when a message reaches a given status.
schemas.ListTriggerConfig: Configuration of a trigger that starts a workflow based on membership of a contact list.
schemas.ContactUpdatedTriggerConfig: Configuration of a trigger that starts a workflow when a contact is updated.
schemas.ContactCreatedTriggerConfig: Configuration of a trigger that starts a workflow when a contact is created.
schemas.FormSubmittedTriggerConfig: Configuration of a trigger that starts a workflow when a form is submitted.
schemas.ChoiceNodeConfig: Configuration of a node that branches on the value of a property.
schemas.ABTestNodeConfig: Configuration of a node that splits contacts between two paths for A/B testing.
schemas.FilterNodeConfig: Configuration of a node that lets only contacts matching its conditions continue.
schemas.IfThenNodeConfig: Configuration of a node that branches depending on whether its conditions are met.
schemas.ListNodeConfig: Configuration of a node that acts on a contact's membership of a list.
schemas.Property: A contact property that can be updated.
schemas.ContactUpdate: A value to set on a contact property.
schemas.UpdateContactNodeConfig: Configuration of a node that updates contact properties.
schemas.Delay: A duration expressed in days, hours and minutes.
schemas.DayOfWeek: Day of the week, from 0 for Sunday to 6 for Saturday.
schemas.AdvancedDelayDays: Days of the week on which a delayed step may continue.
schemas.AdvancedDelayTime: Time of day at which a delayed step continues.
schemas.AdvancedDelay: A delay with an initial duration and optional constraints on the days and time it ends.
schemas.DelayNodeConfig: Configuration of a node that waits before continuing.
schemas.IncrDecrementNodeConfig: Configuration of a node that increments or decrements a numeric property.
schemas.SendMessageToType: Type of recipient a workflow message is sent to.
schemas.SendMessageNodeConfig: Configuration of a node that sends a message.
schemas.SetWorkflowPropertyNodeConfig: Configuration of a node that sets a workflow property to a value.
schemas.LinkClickedNodeConfig: Configuration of a node that waits for a tracked link to be clicked.
schemas.MessageReceivedNodeConfig: Configuration of a node that waits for a reply message.
schemas.GoogleSheetTab: A tab in a Google Sheets spreadsheet.
schemas.UserIntegration: A user's connection to a third-party integration.
schemas.GoogleSheet: A Google Sheets spreadsheet used by a workflow node.
schemas.GoogleSheetColumn: A column in a Google Sheets tab.
schemas.GoogleSheetColumnMapping: Maps a value to a column in a Google Sheets tab.
schemas.GoogleSheetsExportNodeConfig: Configuration of a node that writes values to a Google Sheets spreadsheet.
schemas.GoogleSheetsLookupNodeConfig: Configuration of a node that looks up a value in a Google Sheets spreadsheet.
schemas.WorkflowCondition: A comparison applied to a workflow data reference.
schemas.WorkflowNodeConfig: Configuration of a workflow node, whose shape depends on the node type.
schemas.WorkflowNodePropertyType: Input control type used to edit a workflow node property.
schemas.WorkflowNodePropertyCondition: A condition on another property that controls when a workflow node property applies.
schemas.SelectOption: An option offered for a selectable workflow node property.
schemas.WorkflowNodeProperty: A configurable property of a workflow node type.
schemas.EdgeValidation: Rules for an outgoing edge of a workflow node type.
schemas.NumEdgeConditions: How the number of edges is compared with the required count.
schemas.WorkflowNodeTypeValidation: Rules for the outgoing edges a workflow node type must have.
schemas.WorkflowNodeType: A type of node that can be used in a workflow.
schemas.WorkflowVersion: A version of a workflow and its definition.
schemas.SendMessagesRequest: Request payload for sending a message to contacts, conversations or a filtered set of contacts.
schemas.WorkflowNodeTypeOutputDataType: Data type of a workflow node output.
schemas.WorkflowNodePropertyBaseObject: Base settings shared by workflow node properties.
schemas.WorkflowNodeTypeOutput: A value that a workflow node type produces for later nodes.
schemas.AutorespondersResponse: Paginated response containing a list of autoresponders.

schemas.LinksResponse: Paginated response containing a list of tracked links.
schemas.LinkResponse: Response containing a single tracked link.
schemas.LinkSourcesResponse: Paginated response containing the click sources of a tracked link.

balance.fetch.description: Retrieves the current balance of the account.

accounts.autoresponders.fetchAll.description: Lists the autoresponders configured for the account.

accounts.autoresponders.create.description: Creates an autoresponder that replies automatically to matching incoming messages.

accounts.autoresponders.fetch.description: Retrieves an autoresponder by its ID.

accounts.autoresponders.remove.description: Removes an autoresponder from the account.

accounts.availablephonenumbers.description: Searches for phone numbers available to add to the account, filtered by country, type, area code and other criteria.

contacts.fetchAll.description: Lists the account's contacts, optionally filtered by name, mobile number, email or tags.

contacts.create.description: Creates a contact, or uploads several contacts from a CSV file, merging with existing contacts according to the merge strategy.

contacts.fetch.description: Retrieves a contact by its ID.

contacts.remove.description: Deletes a contact from the account.

messages.fetchAll.description: Lists the account's messages, optionally filtered by contact or conversation.

messages.send.description: Sends a message to the specified contacts, conversations or contacts matching the filters.

templates.fetchAll.description: Lists the account's message templates, optionally filtered by name.

templates.fetch.description: Retrieves a template by its ID.

templates.remove.description: Deletes a template from the account.

campaigns.fetchAll.description: Lists the account's campaigns, optionally filtered by name.

campaigns.create.description: Creates a campaign with its contact filters, template and trigger.

campaigns.createandexecute.description: Creates a campaign for a contact list and executes it immediately or at the scheduled time.

campaigns.fetch.description: Retrieves a campaign by its ID.

campaigns.remove.description: Deletes a campaign from the account.

conversations.fetch.description: Retrieves a conversation by its ID.

links.fetch.description: Lists the account's tracked links, optionally filtered by a search term.

links.fetchById.description: Retrieves a tracked link by its ID.

links.fetchSources.description: Lists the click sources of a tracked link with their statistics.

links.fetchSourceById.description: Retrieves a click source of a tracked link by its ID.

links.fetchSourceStatsById.description: Retrieves click statistics over time for a source of a tracked link.

tools.shareFile.description: Uploads a file and returns a short link that can be used in a message or as MMS media.

accounts.dripcampaigns.create.description: Creates a drip campaign that sends a sequence of timed messages after a trigger event.

accounts.dripcampaigns.fetch.description: Retrieves a drip campaign by its ID.

accounts.dripcampaigns.duplicate.description: Creates a copy of an existing drip campaign.

accounts.dripcampaigns.activate.description: Activates a drip campaign so that it starts enrolling contacts.

accounts.dripcampaigns.deactivate.description: Deactivates a drip campaign so that it stops enrolling contacts.

accounts.dripcampaigns.migrate.description: Converts a drip campaign into a workflow.

accounts.dripcampaigns.executions.description: Lists the contacts' executions of a drip campaign, optionally for a specific workflow version.
